PL-64557 fix PR: https://github.com/methodcrm/method-platform-ui/pull/6188

Root cause: the webpack->rspack migration (#5754 via #6116/#6174) dropped the Buffer polyfill. Import wizard's onNext calls Buffer.from(...).toString('base64') in ImportService.js:30-31 -> ReferenceError before the createSession POST fires -> Next does nothing (no request, no console error). Fix re-adds Buffer to rspack.config.cjs (ProvidePlugin + resolve.fallback) and makes buffer an explicit devDependency. Owning team: Admin (Platform). Note: pinned buffer to ^4.9.2 (already in the lockfile, supports Buffer.from) since npm wasn't available here to regenerate the lock for a 6.x bump.
